thread:
Maria: Heads-up — after the RBAC roles refactor I noticed an embeddings-only API key successfully calling /v1/chat. Saw it in the access logs, stacking with the new role names. Anyone seen scope enforcement flakiness after the refactor? cc @sam @jon

Sam: Can you paste the example request (headers + route)? Also did you check policy-service cache TTL and the token verification path?

Maria: Example (redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-****-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "text-chat-1", "input": "hi"}'
```
Request came from tenant acme; key id: key-rt-9271 (not sending full key).

Jon: This smells like the mapping rename we did — internal policy field changed from `model:embeddings` -> `scope:embeddings`. The enforcer does role-id -> allowed-routes lookup; if the role id wasn't mapped in the migration the policy-service could return a legacy allow.

Kira: Pulled audit for key-rt-9271: shows ALLOW for route /v1/chat at 2025-11-15T13:02:03Z. Notably there was a KMS rotation event at 2025-11-15T12:58:12Z for that tenant. Could the rotation + short cache TTL cause a fallback path that bypasses the new mapping? cc @alex

Alex: Rotation rewraps DEKs; it shouldn’t change policy evaluation. But if token validation path fell back to a cached JWKS or legacy verifier, it might use older role metadata. Can someone grep policy-service logs for `lookup_role` around 13:02?

Sam: There's a policy-service deploy yesterday (PR #4321) that touched the role lookup behavior. I'm starting a rollback to verify. Meanwhile, Maria can you revoke the affected key from KMS so we stop calls?

Maria: Revoke request submitted for key-rt-9271 via KMS UI (action id rev-2025-558). Also filed incident INC-2025-309 with initial notes and logs: https://internal.redwood/cases/INC-2025-309

Jon: If revocation is delayed, we can add an immediate route-level deny for that tenant as a stopgap: `rbacctl set-policy tenant:acme route:/v1/chat deny`

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: policy-service rollback started by sam. CI shows one failing test (scope-migration). Estimated completion ~15m.

Kira: I'll run the audit script across recent keys to see if other tokens were affected: `scripts/audit_scopes.sh --since 2025-11-14 --only-embeddings` — will paste findings here when done.

Maria: Also request we add an alert for any token-validation fallback events: `policy-enforcer.fallback_count > 0` for 1m. That would have flagged this earlier.

Sam: Agreed. I'll open a short RFC to: 1) ensure migration keeps both old and new mappings for a 10m grace window, 2) expand integration tests to exercise per-model vs per-route scopes (embeddings vs chat), and 3) harden KMS rotation tests to avoid verifier fallbacks.

Maria: Thanks all — keeping incident open until revoke + rollback verified. :thumbsup:
